description: This source file implements an 'eye' operation for the Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend in PyTorch. It contains the implementation of functions that generate an identity matrix (or a matrix with ones on the diagonal) using Apple's MPS framework, including error checking, graph caching, and execution logic.

classes.name: CachedGraph
classes.description: A wrapper class inheriting from MPSCachedGraph to cache a specific MPSGraph instance with a key related to the identity matrix operation, including a pointer to the output tensor.

methods.name: eye_out_mps
methods.description: Overloaded functions that create an identity or rectangular matrix (with ones on the diagonal), perform error checking, prepare the MPS graph, and execute it to fill the result tensor with the identity matrix.
